success_definition: Quality only: the v4 engine journal is sealed and binds the study, epoch, source/config references, selection-basis v2, entry-gate trace v1 and KIS frame diagnostics v1.
Quality only: the fresh Toss artifact reaches the planned end without frame/file cap or cleanup failure and remains bound to the exact plan/cohort.
The full returned cohort of at most 100 is preserved; only the ordered first three are Toss-observed and every unobserved row remains explicit.
A conditional 900-second markout is usable only when a valid entry quote is observed by 09:17:55 and a valid bid arrives within the fixed delay. Missing pairs remain unknown.
Capture completion, quote availability and synthetic capacity do not establish feasible fills, execution slippage, strategy profit or account profit.
limitations: One opening-period cohort is not representative of market regimes or a full day.
Toss KRX+NXT LOSSY quotes are not executable KIS quotes, fills, exchange timestamps or tick-complete evidence.
The 383-frame synthetic margin is 0.766% of cap and does not bound October 6 traffic.
KIS capacity is qualified only for the stated synthetic envelope; runtime settings and live-rate capacity remain unresolved.
No economic conclusion is registered; later comparison must retain same candidates and quantities, missed gains, avoided losses, actual costs when verified, and cash constraints.

No capital_policy is embedded. capital_evidence_ref does not establish cash or position feasibility; complete order_ready evidence and separately reviewed evaluation input are required, otherwise price rows remain unknown.
